page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines; an engraved ornament (winged figure) below the middle; imprint lines below it. No margins with text.

main_text.l: Libro elegantissimo,& vtilissimo,il quale contiene Precetti,
per ben regolare l'huomo la sua vita ; viuendo
Essendo tradotti da i versi Essametri Latini,in versi Italiani

page.notes: Engraved winged figure (ornament) between the title lines and the imprint; not transcribed. The page is otherwise clean; show-through from the reverse and a stray mark at the right edge were left out.
